name: Dark Link
description: Dark Link with matte charcoal body/equipment, red eyes, a black native Magic Armor aura and a red MagicBar gauge below the normal magic gauge.

options.name: Appearance diagnostics
options.description: Show appearance and gauge diagnostics, including native pane names and reasons for missing frames/details. Default off; a screenshot is sufficient, no log file needed.

options.name: Duration (seconds)
options.description: Base duration for the short gauge. Doubled after the magic-meter upgrade; charge requirements stay unchanged. Paused in menus and cutscenes. A setting change applies to the next transformation.

options.name: Sword damage (%)
options.description: 100% is normal damage; 200% doubles native sword damage. Native signed damage is capped at 127.

options.name: Free transformation
options.description: Transform without charging and stay transformed until toggled off. Useful for testing the appearance.

options.name: Touch button X
options.description: Legacy starting position, imported only before a touch layout has been saved. Use the in-game Edit button.

options.name: Touch button Y
options.description: Legacy starting position, imported only before a touch layout has been saved. Use the in-game Edit button.
